name: Dishon
overview: The name Dishon appears in Scripture as a significant figure among the Horites, descendants of Seir, in the land of Edom. He is mentioned both as a son of Anah and as a duke or leader among the Horite chiefs, highlighting his role in the genealogies and leadership structure of Seir's people. These references emphasize Dishon's place within the lineage and governance of the Horites, illustrating the biblical record of Edomite ancestry and tribal leadership.
